rows.note: This is the concise all-purpose noun for actual thunder.

example.english: The thunder is really loud today.
example.jyutping: gam1 jat6 di1 leoi4 seng1 hou2 daai6

rows.note: Use this when emphasizing the audible sound of actual thunder.

example.english: The thunder is so loud that I can't sleep.
example.jyutping: leoi4 seng1 gam3 daai6 ngo5 fan3 m4 zoek6

rows.note: Use this for a deep rumbling noise such as distant hoofbeats rather than literal thunder.

example.english: A deep rumbling sound came from the distance, sounding like thunder, as a troop of horses passed by.
example.traditional: 遠處傳來一陣隆隆聲，好似有馬隊行緊過。
example.jyutping: jyun5 cyu3 cyun4 loi4 jat1 zan6 lung4 lung4 seng1 hou2 ci5 jau5 maa5 deoi6 haang4 gan2 gwo3
